propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit commit if (a) a fixing-commit exists whose message resolves to the bug via rebar-ticket trailer, (b) blame of the pre-fix parent over file_impact shows strict majority (>50%) attribution to one commit, and (c) that commit resolves to a ticket via its rebar-ticket trailer; otherwise return None.

The --caused-by <id> parameter on rebar transition allows explicit override of auto-derived caused_by links and must be threaded through _parse_flags, transition_cli, transition_compute, transition_close, and the public transition() facade in _lib_writes.py.

Auto-derived caused_by links must bypass the closed-source guard in _links.add_dependency by writing directly via _write_link_event() after the bug status event is committed, because the source is already closed.
Ambiguous cases (no file_impact, no fixing commit, no >50% dominant commit, or no resolvable trailer) yield no auto-link; resolution failure never blocks close.
The caused_by link edge carries no confidence field; provenance metrics treat blame-auto-derived edges as classified-confidence evidence, not authoritative structural fact.
